text:
lee: spotted plaintext SA key in partner backup object gs://partner-logs-eu/backups/2026-03-21/archive.ndjson. not public but contains `private_key_id` and full key. tagging sec.
sec-bot: LeakScan: evidence item created INC-1804. hash attached. :warning:
ana: can you paste the key_id? we'll need to delete immediately and rotate.
lee: key_id: d4f6c9aa7b8e4f1c. extraction: `gsutil cat ... | jq -r '.payload.service_account.private_key_id'`.
triage: immediate checklist: 1) delete key, 2) revoke refresh tokens (if any), 3) issue new key and ingest into Vault kv-v2, 4) create new KMS key version and rewrap secrets, 5) schedule RBAC audit for partner project.
michael: ops-bot please delete key: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete d4f6c9aa7b8e4f1c --iam-account=redwood-partner-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=partner-prod`
ops-bot: Command queued; executing now.
lee: saving encrypted snapshot for evidence then will remove the GCS object. also checking access logs for reads last 7 days.
sec-bot: Reminder: enable KMS data-access and admin audit logs on partner project, and enable Vault audit device if not present.
ana: key deletion succeeded (200). pushing a short PR to infra to lock Vault path `secret/data/partners/ingest/*` to service `redwood-platform/vault-writer` only.
triage: post-incident follow-ups: add leak-scan rule for `private_key_id`, enforce SA key TTLs, and add partner onboarding checklist to require backups be scrubbed.
